summary: **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** Regulatory Compliance Application on account of change in name of the transmission licensee from ‘Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Limited’ to ‘Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Private Limited’. (Now known as Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Private Limited), Windsor, 1st Floor, Unit No. 101, Kalina, Santacruz East, Mumbai - 400098 ** Petitioner** 2. Order in Petition No. 908/RC/2025 Page 1 - BSES Bhawan,2 nd Floor, B Block, Behind Nehru Place Bus Terminal, Nehru Place, New Delhi-110019 8. Himachal Pradesh State Electricity Board, Vidyut Bhawan, Kumar House Complex, Building No. 11, Shimla. Govt. of Jammu & Kashmir, SLDC Building, 1st Floor, Gladani Powerhouse, Narwal, Jammu. Order in Petition No. 908/RC/2025 Page 2 The Petitioner, Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Limited (now known as Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Private Limited), has filed the present Regulatory Compliance Application seeking approval for the change in the name of the Transmission Licensee from 'Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Limited' to 'GurgaonPalwal Transmission Private Limited'. The Petitioner has made the following prayer: _(b) Take on record the change in name of the transmission licensee/Petitioner from “Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Limited” to “Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Private Limited”;_ _(c) Direct that necessary endorsement be made on the transmission licensee with regard to change of name of “Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Limited” to “Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Private Limited”._ _(d) Pass necessary orders to ensure that no prejudice is caused to the Petitioner on account of the above name change; and_ _(e) Pass any such further/other orders that this Commission may deem fit in the interest of equity and justice.”_ Order in Petition No. 908/RC/2025 Page 3 3. Subsequently, by order dated 22.4.2024 in Petition No. 322/TL/2023, GPTL, was granted a separate inter-State transmission licence bearing Licence No. 118/Transmission/2024/CERC, for establishment of the ‘220 kV line bays (GIS) at 400/220 kV Prithla (GPTL) S/s’ on the Regulated Tariff Mechanism (RTM) mode, in accordance with the provisions of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for grant of Transmission Licence and other related matters) Regulations, 2024. 4. The Petitioner has submitted that an application was filed before the Regional Director (WR), the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Mumbai, seeking approval for the conversion of the company into a Private Limited Company, which was duly approved _vide_ Order dated 10.6.2025 by the Regional Director. Thereafter, the Regional Director sanctioned the alteration of Clause I of the Memorandum of Association, substituting the name " Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Limited " with " Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Private Limited ". Subsequently, consequent upon conversion to a private company, the Assistant Registrar of Companies/ Deputy Registrar of Companies, Manesar, Haryana, issued a Certificate of Incorporation on 26.8.2025, reflecting the new name of the company. 5. Furthermore, the Petitioner has submitted that, consequent to the change of name, there has been no change whatsoever in the constitution, management, shareholding pattern, or directorship of the Petitioner company. The corporate structure remains intact and unaffected by the name change. Order in Petition No. 908/RC/2025 Page 4 7. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and perused the documents available on record. The Petitioner was granted the TBCB transmission licence _vide_ order dated 29.9.2016 in Petition No. 122/TL/2016, and the tariff was adopted _vide_ order dated 6.9.2016 in Petition No. 120/AT/2016. Subsequently, the transmission licence (RTM Mode) was granted _vide_ order dated 22.4.2024 in Petition No. 322/TL/2023. 8. Consequent to the issuance of the certificate dated 26.8.2025, by the Assistant Registrar of Companies/ Deputy Registrar of Companies, Manesar, Haryana, as noted above, we direct that the name of the Transmission Licensee be changed from “Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Limited " to "Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Private Limited” in the records of the Commission. It is further stipulated that Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Private Limited shall remain unequivocally bound by the terms and conditions of the inter-State Transmission Licence originally granted to GurgaonPalwal Transmission Limited, as well as by the provisions of the Transmission Licence Regulations. 9. We direct that the necessary endorsement be made on the Transmission Licence with regard to the change of name of “Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Limited” to “Gurgaon-Palwal Transmission Private Limited”. Except for the name, there shall be no change in the terms and conditions of the licence. 10. Let an extract copy of this order be sent to the Central Government (the Ministry of Power), the Central Electricity Authority and Central Transmission Utility of India Limited in terms of sub-section (7) of Section 15 of the Electricity Act, 2003, for their information and record. Order in Petition No. 908/RC/2025 Page 5 **Sd/sd/sd/sd/(Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Member Chairperson**
